topic: Muting a busy group text thread so it stops buzzing your phone all day
headline: Quiet A Noisy Group Text
supporting_text: Mute one conversation's alerts without leaving the chat or missing messages.
caption:
⚡ TODAY’S 30-SECOND TECH WIN

Some group texts turn into a nonstop stream of buzzes, especially around holidays or family planning.

Good news: you can quiet just that one conversation, while still being able to check it anytime.

Open the group chat, tap the names at the top, and turn on Hide Alerts (sometimes labeled Notify Me).

The messages still arrive, but your phone stays calm and quiet.

Save this tip for later.

Follow @DigitalCalmDaily for one simple 30-Second Tech Win every day.
visual_symbol: A phone with a bell icon crossed out beside a chat bubble
reel_steps: Tap the group name at the top
